title: Trump oo Stephen Miller u magacaabay madaxa shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad
summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Stephen Miller, oo ahaa ku-xigeenka madaxa shaqaalaha isla markaana dejiyay siyaasadda adag ee socdaalka, u magacaabay inuu beddelo Susie Wiles, kadib khasaaraha taariikhiga ah ee Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ka soo gaaray doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe, sida ay werisay France 24.
originalTitle: Stephen Miller named White House Chief of Staff
imageAlt: Stephen Miller oo saaran diyaaradda Air Force One, 2017

en.title: Trump names Stephen Miller White House chief of staff
en.summary: President Donald Trump has named Stephen Miller, the deputy chief of staff and architect of his tough immigration policy, to replace Susie Wiles, after the Republican Party's historic losses in the midterm elections, France 24 reported.
en.imageAlt: Stephen Miller aboard Air Force One, 2017

ar.title: ترامب يعيّن ستيفن ميلر كبيراً لموظفي البيت الأبيض
ar.summary: عيّن الرئيس دونالد ترامب ستيفن ميلر، نائب كبير الموظفين ومهندس سياسة الهجرة المتشددة، خلفاً لسوزي وايلز، بعد الخسائر التاريخية التي مُني بها الحزب الجمهوري في انتخابات التجديد النصفي، بحسب قناة فرانس 24.
ar.imageAlt: ستيفن ميلر على متن طائرة الرئاسة الأمريكية، 2017

fr.title: Trump nomme Stephen Miller chef de cabinet de la Maison Blanche
fr.summary: Le président Donald Trump a nommé Stephen Miller, chef de cabinet adjoint et architecte de sa politique migratoire stricte, pour remplacer Susie Wiles, après les pertes historiques du Parti républicain aux élections de mi-mandat, a rapporté France 24.
fr.imageAlt: Stephen Miller à bord d'Air Force One, 2017

nl.title: Trump benoemt Stephen Miller tot stafchef van het Witte Huis
nl.summary: President Donald Trump heeft Stephen Miller, plaatsvervangend stafchef en architect van zijn harde immigratiebeleid, benoemd als opvolger van Susie Wiles, na de historische verliezen van de Republikeinse Partij bij de tussentijdse verkiezingen, meldde France 24.
nl.imageAlt: Stephen Miller aan boord van Air Force One, 2017

it.title: Trump nomina Stephen Miller capo di gabinetto della Casa Bianca
it.summary: Il presidente Donald Trump ha nominato Stephen Miller, vice capo di gabinetto e artefice della sua dura politica sull'immigrazione, al posto di Susie Wiles, dopo le storiche sconfitte del Partito repubblicano alle elezioni di metà mandato, ha riferito France 24.
it.imageAlt: Stephen Miller a bordo dell'Air Force One, 2017

de.title: Trump ernennt Stephen Miller zum Stabschef des Weißen Hauses
de.summary: Präsident Donald Trump hat Stephen Miller, den stellvertretenden Stabschef und Architekten seiner harten Einwanderungspolitik, zum Nachfolger von Susie Wiles ernannt, nach den historischen Verlusten der Republikanischen Partei bei den Zwischenwahlen, berichtete France 24.
de.imageAlt: Stephen Miller an Bord der Air Force One, 2017

tr.title: Trump, Stephen Miller'ı Beyaz Saray Genel Sekreteri olarak atadı
tr.summary: France 24'ün haberine göre Başkan Donald Trump, Cumhuriyetçi Parti'nin ara seçimlerdeki tarihi kayıplarının ardından, genel sekreter yardımcısı ve sert göç politikasının mimarı Stephen Miller'ı Susie Wiles'ın yerine atadı.
tr.imageAlt: Air Force One uçağında Stephen Miller, 2017

es.title: Trump nombra a Stephen Miller jefe de gabinete de la Casa Blanca
es.summary: El presidente Donald Trump nombró a Stephen Miller, jefe de gabinete adjunto y artífice de su dura política migratoria, para sustituir a Susie Wiles, tras las pérdidas históricas del Partido Republicano en las elecciones de mitad de mandato, informó France 24.
es.imageAlt: Stephen Miller a bordo del Air Force One, 2017
